caption: MongoDB running locally in Docker (replica set, healthy)
Backend (Node.js + Express) started and connected to MongoDB
Frontend running at http://localhost:3000
Login page (password, then authenticator code)
Q1.1 Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes, never plaintext
Q1.1 Server checks the password, then the code, then sets a signed JWT in an HttpOnly cookie with expiry
Q1.1 The JWT payload: subject, session ID, issuer, audience and expiry (no role inside)
Q1.1 After refreshing a protected page the user is still signed in
Q1.3 Logout deletes the session on the server; replaying the same cookie fails, also from a second tab
Q1.4 401 = not signed in, 403 = signed in but not allowed; errors never show hashes or exceptions
Q1.2 / Q2.1 Owner, status and timestamps come only from the server session; forged fields are rejected
Q2.1 Form checks before sending: title of at least 5 characters, description of at least 15, category required
Q2.1 The server validates again (the browser can be bypassed)
Q2.4 Submitted from the form: saved as Pending, version 1, title trimmed, shown in the list
Q2.4 201 Created: the response is the record as committed in MongoDB (server owner, unique ID, Pending, timestamps)
Q2.2 Same title in different case: conflict shown to the user
Q2.2 Five simultaneous submissions (case/space variants): exactly one record
Q2.2 A different owner may use the same title
Q2.3 Forced audit/history write failure: the record is not saved either (one transaction)
Q2.4 The server was stopped and started again: the record is still there (MongoDB on disk)
Q3 A Search + category + status filters combined, page 2 of 2 (5 per page), only the owner's records
Q3 A One listing endpoint: case-insensitive search, filters combined with AND, scope applied before counting and paging
Q3 A Invalid page, sort and filter values are rejected
Q3 B The Manager (Role 2) sees Pending requests from all staff, plus ones they claimed
Q3 B SR-1054 is Pending, version 1: only "Claim for review" is offered
Q3 B Claimed: In Review, version 2, reviewer recorded, history event added
Q3 B A rejection without a reason is refused
Q3 B Rejected with a reason: terminal (no more actions), version 3, full history
Q3 B Two simultaneous claims with the same version: one success, one conflict, one transition event
Q3 B Finalize without claim or as the wrong actor is denied; stale versions conflict; terminal records cannot change
Q3 C The owner sees the full history (status, actor, time, version) and only a masked contact number
Q3 C History endpoint restricted to the owner and the authorized reviewer
Q3 C Role 1 cannot access another owner's record by changing IDs; the contact number is protected
Q3 C A failed transition leaves the record and history unchanged
Q3 D Invalid payloads and non-existent IDs get clear, safe errors
Q3 D Database stopped: the API answers 503 and nothing is saved (no false success)
Q3 D Automated tests (node:test): Q1 and Q2
Q3 D Automated tests (node:test): Q3, including concurrency and authorization cases
Database schema: collections and indexes (unique owner + normalized title; one history event per version)
Stored records in MongoDB (staff_requests)
Status changes and their history events in MongoDB
The app's database login can only add and read history (append-only), never edit or delete it
